SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: NAMES OF SCRIPTURES
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Names of Scriptures helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: NAMES OF SCRIPTURES
Study Names of Scriptures like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Recognise scriptures answering questions on the from the four faiths for images of the scriptures awareness of his/her displayed. faith • The

What this means
In this part you learn to recognise scriptures answering questions on the from the four faiths for images of the scriptures awareness of his/her displayed. faith • The. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recognise scriptures answering questions on the from the four faiths for images of the scriptures awareness of his/her displayed. faith • The.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Names of Scriptures” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recognise scriptures answering questions on the from the four faiths for images of the scriptures awareness of his/her displayed. faith • The. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the participate in colouring scriptures as sacred. activities

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the participate in colouring scriptures as sacred. activities. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the participate in colouring scriptures as sacred. activities.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Names of Scriptures in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the participate in colouring scriptures as sacred. activities. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Names of Scriptures is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Names of Scriptures” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: recognise scriptures answering questions on the from the four faiths for images of the scriptures awareness of his/her displayed. faith • The)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Names of Scriptures in your own words. (skill: appreciate the participate in colouring scriptures as sacred. activities)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Names of Scriptures to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: recognise scriptures answering questions on the from the four faiths for images of the scriptures awareness of his/her displayed. faith • The.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the participate in colouring scriptures as sacred. activities.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Names of Scriptures from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Names of Scriptures: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Names of Scriptures?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Where is the Scripture kept (4 lessons) a) name scriptures to Granth Sahib Ji, Kalpasutra in your house?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Names of Scriptures means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: recognise scriptures answering questions on the from the four faiths for images of the scriptures awareness of his/her displayed. faith • The.
5. Be able to: appreciate the participate in colouring scriptures as sacred. activities.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
